items.text: Incorporated round 2 decisions into plan.md: (D3) manual visual verification only — no automated tests for this CSS-only change; (D4) remove the conditional md:right-[21.5rem] className from the FAB in GraphWorkspace.tsx since the sidebar at z-40 now covers the FAB.

Scope expanded from 2 files to 3 files: floating-action-button.tsx (bottom position), Sidebar.tsx (z-index), and GraphWorkspace.tsx (remove right-offset). All changes are single-line CSS/className edits.
Testable dimension remains at 2 because verification is manual-only. This is appropriate for a pure CSS visual fix — the trade-off was explicitly accepted in D3. All other dimensions are at 3.
Plan is ready for execution. No remaining gaps or open questions.

plan_updates: Added D3 (manual verification) and D4 (remove FAB right-offset) to Accepted Decisions. Added GraphWorkspace.tsx to files-to-modify table. Added Step 3 to implementation plan. Updated acceptance criteria to include right-offset removal. Updated testing strategy to reflect manual-only approach.
